uri.description: A URI (RFC 3986), at least one character. `format: uri` is an assertion only where the validator asserts formats (this contract's validator loads ajv-formats); a validator that treats format as an annotation also accepts a string that is not a URI.

timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 date-time. `format: date-time` is an assertion only where the validator asserts formats (this contract's validator loads ajv-formats); a validator that treats format as an annotation accepts any string here.

semver.description: A semantic version, major.minor.patch with an optional pre-release and build (semver.org 2.0.0), no leading zeros in the numbers.

sha256.description: A content hash: sha256: and 64 lower-case hex digits. The bare 64-digit form, without the prefix, is sha256Hex.

sha256Hex.description: A bare SHA-256: 64 lower-case hex digits, without the sha256: prefix that sha256 carries.

revisionRef.description: A reference to one immutable revision of a versioned document: its id, its revision number and the content hash of that revision (docs/specification/versioning.md#revision-shape).

revisionMeta.description: The meta block of a versioned document: id, revision, content hash, when and by whom the revision was created (docs/specification/versioning.md#revision-shape).

dataClass.description: The classification of data, least to most sensitive (docs/specification/governance-and-roles.md#data-classification).

effectClass.description: The class of an external effect a capability may have; none is read-only (docs/specification/governance-and-roles.md#external-effects).

extensions.description: An extensions object: every key is a URI that names its extension, and each value is that extension's own (docs/specification/overview.md#extension-rule).

artifact.description: A produced artifact: its id, media type, location, content hash, classification and the revision that produced it (docs/specification/results-and-evidence.md#artifacts).

agentId.description: A registry agent id: a provider id, or a service id optionally followed by .instance (DEC-0016, DEC-0039).

capabilityName.description: A capability's name as a tool is called (DEC-0020): a lower-case letter, then 1 to 127 of [a-z0-9._-] (docs/specification/interop.md#capability-names). A capability's identity in an admission, a binding or a route is a URI: capabilityUri.

capabilityUri.description: A capability's identity in an admission, a binding or a runner route: a URI. The name a tool is called by is capabilityName (DEC-0020, docs/specification/interop.md#capability-names).

slug.description: A lower-case identifier of 2 to 63 characters: a letter, then letters, digits and hyphens. The shape of a service id, a runner kind, a pipeline id and a product id (DEC-0016).

contextId.description: DEC-0082: the context a grant is used in or an agent instance runs in: personal, or org:<orgId>, where orgId is the organization server's opaque id of the organization: a letter or digit, then up to 127 of [A-Za-z0-9_-] (1-128 characters, an enrollment's org.id can be any such id). Compared as written: never case-folded, never by prefix (docs/specification/contexts.md).

orgContextId.description: DEC-0086: an organization's context, org:<orgId>: contextId without personal. What a share registration and a grant.usage carry, the grant's own context. Compared as written (docs/specification/contexts.md).

shareGrantId.description: DEC-0086, FAC-SEM-117: the meta.id of a share grant into an organization: urn:fabric:share: and 32 lower-case hex digits, 128 bits from a CSPRNG, never derived from a name, an address, an estate id, an agentRef or the organization, and never all zeros. The pattern admits only its own normal form (DEC-0076), so it is compared as written; it holds no person's name, address or estate id (docs/specification/share-registration.md).

traceId.description: A W3C Trace Context trace id: 32 lower-case hex digits, never all zeros.

spanId.description: A W3C Trace Context span id: 16 lower-case hex digits, never all zeros.

partial.description: DEC-0087: true when a number is a lower bound or unknown (null). An unknown number is null, never 0; 0 is a measured zero.

usage.description: A job's or a result's usage. A number nobody measured is null, never 0; `partial` is true when a number is a lower bound or unknown (DEC-0087). A provider writes null and `partial` only toward a caller whose request `_meta.protocols` names fabric-interop/0.2; toward any other it writes the lower bound it measured.

protocols.description: The protocol revisions a party reads (DEC-0067): for each protocol at most N and N−1, consecutive in the contract's register (FAC-SEM-099).

ed25519PublicKeyBase64url.description: A 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding, canonical (the last character's two spare bits zero). Never a key of small order (DEC-0045, CT-29): the enum lists libsodium's seven encodings with the sign bit clear and set. The same key in standard base64 is ed25519PublicKeyBase64.

ed25519PublicKeyBase64.description: A raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, standard base64 with its padding, canonical (the last character's two spare bits zero). Never a key of small order (DEC-0045, CT-29): the enum lists libsodium's seven encodings with the sign bit clear and set. The same key in base64url is ed25519PublicKeyBase64url.
